description: CUDA (NVRTC tracer, fp32) vs WebGPU (web app, Chrome-based in-app browser) on the same RTX 3070, same scene, same image size. Final 8-bit display images compared per pixel (after bloom, tone mapping and grading). This is an image comparison, not the Phase 2 fate-map gate (step 4).

image.note: The web canvas at render scale 0.75 in the in-app browser; CUDA rendered with --snapshot <id> --size 719 402

observation: Differences concentrate on the thin secondary Einstein ring of the star field near the photon orbit, where f32 rounding decides which sky cell a ray reaches.
